paper_title: Explainable AI-Enabled Wearable Sensors for Real-Time Thrombotic Event Early Warning in Connected Health Environments

entries.claim: two sensor modalities yield a 19-feature tensor (12 HRV plus 7 temperature)
four dilated causal layers with kernel three give a 31-step receptive field
temporal self-attention aggregates to a distribution over time steps
spatial feature attention sums to one over the 19 features
a clinical relevance vector is read from knowledge-graph node degree
the clinical prior weight anneals linearly to zero over the warmup window
focal loss with gamma two addresses class imbalance
the head maps the pooled and context vectors to a risk probability
a 70/15/15 subject-level partition keeps every patient inside one split
AdamW with weight decay one e-4 under cosine annealing
the loop runs the configured epochs and keeps the best validation checkpoint
symmetric integer quantisation shrinks the edge model to 0.13 MB
test accuracy 91.3 and AUROC 0.936, ahead of the best baseline
the ablation rows reproduce every reported component gain

entries.note: the aggregates are internally consistent, but the Waveform cohort is credentialed so no value is recomputed from source waveforms

entries.claim: 89.3 per cent sensitivity and 91.5 per cent specificity at 156 participants
entries.note: the prospective cohort is not released, and the published 2x2 counts do not reproduce the reported specificity

deviations.what_departs: the full model carries 1.36M parameters against a tabulated 1.08M
deviations.why: the manuscript leaves the spatial-attention inner width and the per-feature embedding width unnamed; the release fixes them at 64 and 256 as recorded in docs/deviations.md D6

deviations.what_departs: the smoke cohort is 96 subjects at 48 steps, hidden width 48
deviations.why: the Waveform records cannot be redistributed and the full-width model does not fit inside a CPU smoke budget

deviations.what_departs: the smoke trains two epochs with dropout disabled
deviations.why: the smoke exists to show the pipeline runs end to end, so the schedule is shortened and dropout is switched off to keep the run repeatable

deviations.what_departs: the reported specificity of 91.5 per cent is left unreconciled
deviations.why: 109 true negatives over 120 condition negatives is 90.8 per cent, so the smoke reports the gap rather than bending the arithmetic; no source records exist to settle it
